description: This file defines the FooTable.Filtering component, which adds filtering UI and functionality to a FooTable instance, including search input, column selection, and filtering logic.

classes.name: F.Filtering
classes.description: Filtering component class extending FooTable.Component, responsible for managing filtering UI and logic.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and sets filtering options before UI creation, based on data and element classes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filtering component and creates the UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes filtering UI and cleans up.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Generates filtering UI elements including search input, dropdown, and buttons.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Filters rows based on current filters before they are rendered.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates UI elements and filter button state during draw cycle.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds or updates a filter with specified parameters.

methods.name: removeFilter
methods.description: Removes a filter by name.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies filters to the table, raising events before and after.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears current filters and applies the change.

methods.name: setButton
methods.description: Updates filter button icon based on filter state.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a filter by name.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns columns applicable for filtering, based on dropdown selection or filterable columns.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures an array of filters are valid FooTable.Filter instances.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter object from parameters.

methods.name: _ensure
methods.description: Validates and constructs a filter object.

methods.name: _onSearchInputChanged
methods.description: Handles input change events for search input, triggers filtering with delay.

methods.name: _onSearchButtonClicked
methods.description: Handles search button click, toggles filter state.

methods.name: _onSearchColumnClicked
methods.description: Handles checkbox clicks in column dropdown, updates filters.

methods.name: _onDropdownToggleClicked
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the column dropdown menu.

methods.name: _onDocumentClicked
methods.description: Closes dropdown if clicking outside.
